question:
(i) Explain how a neutral metal sphere can be charged negatively by induction using a positively charged rod.
(ii) What is the role of earthing in this process?

options.A:
(i) Touch a positive rod to the sphere so that electrons leave the sphere
(ii) Earthing removes electrons from the sphere
options.B:
(i) Bring the positive rod near and then remove it before earthing
(ii) Earthing prevents all charge motion
options.C:
(i) Bring a positive rod near, earth the sphere so electrons flow from earth into it, disconnect earth first, then remove the rod; the sphere becomes negative
(ii) Earthing supplies electrons, allowing the sphere to gain net negative charge
options.D:
(i) Bring the positive rod near and earth the rod instead of the sphere
(ii) Earthing makes the sphere positive
